summary: 707 Cayman Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 5, 2026. Shareholders approved an ordinary resolution increasing authorized share capital from US$500,000 into 2,083,333 shares to US$12,000,000 divided into 45,000,000 Class A and 5,000,000 Class B shares, by creating additional shares. The resolution passed with 98.68% of votes cast in favor. Class B shareholders, holding 25 votes per share, voted unanimously in favor. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter, not a special situation.
